title: The First Farewell
hook: One day, Shams was gone from Konya. And Rumi, the scholar, became a poet of grief.

segments.fa: بشنیده‌ام که عزم سفر می‌کنی مکن
segments.en: I have heard you mean to travel. Do not.

segments.fa: مهر حریف و یار دگر می‌کنی مکن
segments.en: You give your love to another friend. Do not.

segments.fa: تو در جهان غریبی غربت چه می‌کنی
segments.en: You are a stranger in this world. Why choose exile?

tafsir: The jealousy in Konya grew into open hostility.
After little more than a year, Shams left the city without a word.
Rumi was shattered. He turned to music, to whirling, and to poetry.
This ghazal begs a beloved not to leave.
We cannot say it was written that day. But it carries that grief.
When word came that Shams was in Damascus, Rumi sent his son, Sultan Walad, to bring him home.

outro.say: Part six. Shams returns. And then he vanishes for good. Follow The Guest House.
outro.title: Part 6 · The return, and the final disappearance
